This memorandum provides a status update regarding the employment discrimination matter for Apex Global Solutions LLC (Defendant) in Meridian Technologies Inc. v. Apex Global Solutions LLC, USDC NDCA Case No. 2024-CV-12055. Our analysis confirms the applicability of the Age Discrimination in Employment Act (ADEA) and Title VII of the Civil Rights Act to the claims of age discrimination and retaliation brought by the former VP of Engineering. Precedent from the 9th Circuit and related federal jurisprudence has been reviewed, supporting potential motions for summary judgment and dismissal standards under FRCP 56 and 12(b)(6). A motion to compel was recommended to address discovery deficiencies; however, the filing action was not approved at this time. The discovery cutoff remains pending on January 15, 2025, with a key deadline for response to interrogatories due January 10, 2025. We continue to monitor all deadlines and will advise on next steps regarding discovery compliance and motion practice in advance of upcoming dates.
